source: Comparison page, not a genre guide: FIGURES.md's canon pass does not apply. The roster is the festivals that pass four stated tests (electronic core, DJ Mag Top 100 Festivals 2026, a European home edition expected in 2027, a distinct sound or setting). Ranks from djmag-festival-priorities.md (checked 15 September 2026): Tomorrowland 1, Untold 3, Defqon.1 5, Creamfields 7, Kappa FuturFestival 8, Parookaville 10, Time Warp 14, Mysteryland 15, Dekmantel 17, Boomtown 20, Monegros 26, Awakenings 34, Sónar 38, Ultra Europe 47.
note: Dates read on each festival's official site on 2026-09-22; for festivals with a guide on this site, the guide's own sourced 2027 block was used and matches. Unannounced on that day: Tomorrowland, Dekmantel, Monegros. Images are Wikimedia Commons and new to this page: Defqon.1 Red stage 2022 (Blyra92, CC BY-SA 4.0), Kappa FuturFestival Futur Stage 2025 (MadBob, CC BY 4.0), Monegros 2009 (BigSus, CC BY 2.5). A Boomtown Paradise Heights photograph (Sam Warrenger, CC BY 4.0) was downloaded to img/europe-festivals/ but not placed, because the section had no room for a third media block. Sets: Four Tet at Dekmantel 2025 (Dekmantel channel), Pearson Sound at Boomtown 2025 (Keep Hush), both from the catalogue, oEmbed-checked 2026-09-22. Smaller-festivals section (added 2026-09-22): Nachtdigital 2014 photograph (Robert Richter for Nachtdigital, CC BY 2.0) and Ezio Aguiar's sunrise set at Garbicz 2025 (artist's channel, IhBa3o5YYME), oEmbed-checked.
